title: Young Woman on Mountain Road, 1940s B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length outdoor portrait of a stylish young woman standing beside a mountain road. She is dressed in late 1930s or early 1940s fashion, wearing a light-colored button-front dress with a dark scarf collar accent, a waist belt, and cut-out sandals while holding a handbag. The backdrop features forested hillsides and a distant road sign. A slight light leak or lens flare overexposure is visible on the lower right side of the photo.
